authorization: 同意，请先对2025年展开研究；承接上一轮提出的2025公告相关动作方法评审。完成后一并提交RSCH文档已有修改。
user_role_document_change: Include the existing one-line request to explain financial terminology in plain Chinese; do not expand role-document edits
fixed_question: At predeclared original C0056 decision nodes within2025's single disclosed abnormal-trading episode, what is the year-end total path value of canceling one pending entry versus forcing one early exit, each followed by original policy?
purpose: Determine whether new action-value evidence would change the research route; no presumed alpha, annual repair, causal catalyst or learned rule
original_constraints: All original fees, lots, limits, T+1 execution, raw-execution/research-price roles, annual goals and baseline unchanged

year_context.not_solved_by_method: June3 early exit predates the three June notices; other2025 dates and original annual drawdown/frequency still matter

sources.official_episode: Exactly3 matched2025 documents forming1 episode in the complete current-source catalogue; prior14-document2020-2025 universe is context only

node_selection.general_notice_trigger: First conservative availability of the episode's original general upward abnormal-trading disclosure, not the later detailed operating statement
node_selection.rule: Within that fixed episode on ORIGINAL unmodified C0056, select first D with PLAN_BUY; separately select first D with held_at_close and original HOLD posture, including a buy filled on D that may be sold only at E=D+1
node_selection.detailed_notice_limit: June18 notice's recent-company-selling-price statement only conservatively available at June19 close; after that original episode has zero PLAN_BUY nodes. It cannot be used to justify June18 entry cancellation.
node_selection.interpretation: Same episode, different decision nodes, wealth denominators and information sets. This is not an experiment holding all information constant while changing posture.
node_selection.missing_or_changed_node: Fail/unsupported, never shift to another favorable date or construct a new holding state

proposed_paths.X_original: Reuse authenticated unchanged C0056 full original path; no new account dispatch
proposed_paths.NOOP: New source with NOOP parameters must match original full-window economic ledgers and original signal columns before any intervention dispatch
proposed_paths.S_skip_buy_once: From original full history, at entry D only remove the original BUY intent and set target/entry_signal to zero; preserve prior flat-state reservation. Do not fabricate failed-buy reset or an entry/deadline/reservation for an unfilled position. From next session recompute unmodified original policy; subsequent real buys establish their own clocks.
proposed_paths.H_force_sell_once: Independently from original full history, at held D only request SELL/exit_pending in place of original HOLD. Preserve June19 actual entry, original deadline and reservation. Actual fill obeys original T+1, suspension, limits and fees; blocked sale stays pending. After actual sale resume unmodified original policy with the retained reservation.
proposed_paths.not_combined: H does not start from S; S may have no June19 position, so chaining would invent an impossible common state

terminal_and_normalization.unique_primary_T: 2025-12-31 close, verified original last2025 trading session; no forced liquidation
terminal_and_normalization.choice: Matches user2025 annual question and includes possible re-participation; no E9/E21 or other endpoint scan. An original H10 liquidation-day endpoint would omit later participation.
terminal_and_normalization.calculation_window: Original2020-01-02 through2026-10-15 full-window account/start/cash/input contract for NOOP and historical state preservation; only2025 predeclared intervention, only2025 terminal used for the action question
terminal_and_normalization.future_tail: 2026 has no role in choosing the intervention, endpoint or reported action outcome; retain as original technical contract/control only
terminal_and_normalization.annual_context: Also show (W_arm(T)-W_X(T))/original2025 opening equity as original annual-return difference; all arms share that opening history. Different D-normalized effects cannot rank the best action at one common state.
terminal_and_normalization.terminal_state: Disclose cash, quantity, same-price mark, pending buy/sell, original/future clock and whether state paths reconverged. Year end need not mean risk is extinguished.

cash_and_participation_attribution.flat_reference: At entry D original is cash-only. Freezing that actual D cash until T gives exact no-new-trades reference under original no-interest contract; no assumed sale or fee.
cash_and_participation_attribution.held_original_disposition_base: For each X/H separately, identify first actual sale of the original June19 inventory; freeze actual post-sale cash through T. If current inventory has not sold by T, use its original same-price terminal wealth and explicitly mark it as unsold valuation, not cash.
cash_and_participation_attribution.identity: For each held arm W_j(T)=B_j(T)+R_j(T), where B_j is original-position disposition/frozen-cash-or-unsold-mark base and R_j is post-disposition participation contribution. W_H-W_X=(B_H-B_X)+(R_H-R_X).
cash_and_participation_attribution.limits: Post-sale contribution includes downstream sizing, fees and market exposure; not an independent alpha component or a pure old-position return. Derive references from actual evaluated fills, never assume June20 execution succeeds.

minimum_future_execution_budget.diagnostic_candidate_identity: Public EvaluationRequest requires StrategyCandidate; each new immutable mode/parameter identity is diagnostic and remains unregistered. Allocate distinct identities in the future authorized experiment; do not overwrite C0056.
minimum_future_execution_budget.scheduling: NOOP first; if exact equivalence passes, run S then H, single worker/native thread. Any economic/state discrepancy stops later dispatch.
minimum_future_execution_budget.failure_counting: Each dispatched SUCCESS/FAILED/CANCELLED/UNKNOWN consumes one slot; uncertain dispatch conservatively consumes a slot. No automatic retry or replacement.
minimum_future_execution_budget.preparation: Verify existing public dataset/source/bound identities and full source snapshot locally. A missing or incompatible asset stops before dispatch; do not claim cached reuse or silently fetch new data.

prototype_checks_now: Original toy-history NOOP target and existing observed columns identical; new audit columns separate
Skip cancels original single BUY intent, has no virtual entry anchor or failed-buy flag, then permits ordinary next-session recomputation
Force sell preserves original anchor and reservation, enforces T+1 and pending behavior through suspension/limit failure
No eligible original node, duplicate intervention or invalid mode/date fails without selecting another day
Identical original input/decision/execution definitions and source-contained implementation; no platform modification
required_checks_if_execution_authorized: Public input bindings and fixed source/parameters/design hashed before any run; no original candidate mutation
Full NOOP original economic ledgers and original signal columns equivalent, including failed buys, fills, fees, orders, quantity and NAV
S/H identical to original through D before intervention, same original node wealth; exactly one permitted intent change
Current-cycle identity and actual exit cash/terminal mark verified before cash attribution
Full-window account runs retained, report unique2025 year-end endpoint and original yearly target context; no filter-by-saved-PnL simulation

decision_routes.improvement: A positive total path effect motivates assessing materiality against the original52.4625pp2025 shortfall, drawdown and participation attribution. It does not validate a general warning predictor or promote a candidate.
decision_routes.no_improvement: Close this exact single-action design or revise its mechanism explanation using the full path; do not rescue with another date, terminal, window or blackout duration.
decision_routes.identification_limit: Only one2025 announcement episode; neither statistical generalization nor new unseen evidence is available regardless of favorable local outcome.
decision_routes.technical_or_support_failure: Report unavailable/failed branch honestly and stop unauthorized dispatch; no synthetic cash reset, alternate matcher or budget renewal
